title: Get emergency access to a production GCP project
summary: Get temporary owner access to a production Google Cloud project when an incident cannot be fixed through the pipeline. The access ends by itself after four hours and every action is recorded.

resources.title: Emergency access runbook
resources.description: What the access allows, how it is recorded and what to do if the tool is down.

prerequisites.title: An open incident
prerequisites.description: Emergency access is only given for a SEV1 or SEV2 incident with a PagerDuty number.

prerequisites.title: Member of the emergency access group of your team
prerequisites.description: The group gcp-<team>-breakglass; ask for it before you join the on-call rota.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The on-call engineer working on the incident.

actors.name: Incident commander
actors.description: Approves the access; must be someone else than you.

steps.title: Ask for emergency access
instructions: Open the access portal and choose 'Emergency access - GCP production'.
Choose the project and enter the PagerDuty incident number.
Write in one sentence what you need to do that the pipeline cannot.

steps.title: Approve the emergency access
steps.description: Four eyes: the incident commander confirms the incident and the reason.

steps.title: Fix it through the pipeline instead
instructions: Make the change in the infrastructure repository.
Ask a second engineer for a fast review and merge.

steps.title: Make only the change you asked for
steps.description: Everything you do is recorded. The access ends after four hours, or earlier when you give it back.
instructions: Open the GCP console with the emergency role.
Make the change and post each action in the incident channel.
Give the access back in the access portal when you are done.

steps.title: Bring the infrastructure code in line
steps.description: A change made by hand is undone by the next pipeline run unless the code says the same.
instructions: Write the same change in the infrastructure repository within one working day.
Put the incident number in the pull request title.

steps.title: Check the recorded actions
steps.description: The team compares the recorded actions with the reason given and raises anything unexpected with Cyber Security.
